description: A React component named ProtectedRoute that safeguards routes by checking user authentication status. It displays a loading message during auth loading, redirects to /auth if unauthenticated, and renders child components if authenticated.

methods.name: ProtectedRoute({ children })
methods.description: React function component that conditionally renders its children based on user authentication status, redirecting unauthenticated users to /auth.

parameters.name: children
parameters.description: Child components to be rendered if user is authenticated.
